Ava: Quick async check-in for this quarter's cross-pillar milestones — please drop 1) what shipped, 2) what slipped, 3) who owns next steps. Trying to collate before Friday exec sync.

Ben: Shipped: v2 smart routing + fallback policy (deployed to prod us-west yesterday). PR: https://git.redwood/v2-routing :tada:

Ravi: Slipped: Dedicated autoscale work — hit GPU driver regression on the qa cluster, blocked by infra rollback. Owning triage, ETA EOW if drivers stable.

Maya: Ben — can you drop a CR on my perf tweaks for KV cache? Two small changes, then I can land and run load tests. Pinged you in the PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4521

Ben: On it, should review today. If green, I'll merge and kick the load job.

Carmen: Dependency note — AuthTeam needs to finish token exchange spec before Private deploy tests can proceed. AuthTeam, any update? @AuthTeam

AuthTeam: We're wrapping up spec review, ETA tomorrow AM. We'll post a short changelog and sample responses.

deploy-bot: deploy:v2-routing -> prod/us-west succeeded (2026-03-12 09:42 UTC). No rollbacks.

Leah: Summary / next actions: 1) Ben to review Maya's CR (today). 2) Ravi to share rollback plan + test matrix for autoscale (EOW). 3) AuthTeam to publish token-exchange spec (tomorrow AM). 4) Product to decide canary window for Private tests — @Ava to confirm by Thu.

Ava: Confirming canary window Thursday 10–12 PT. Also, for the exec sheet: shipped = v2 routing; slipped = autoscale; risks = auth spec delay, autoscale driver instability.

Maya: Noted, will queue a canary run after Ben merges (need ~2 hours of warm cache).

Ravi: If driver fix lands earlier, I can accelerate. I'll post status in this thread.

Ben: Merged Maya's perf fixes, kicked load test. Results look promising, p95 token latency down 8%. :thumbsup:

Leah: Great. I'll update the milestone spreadsheet and tag owners. If anything changes, reply here so I can track.

Ava: Thanks all — closing async loop unless new blockers. :rocket:
